FULL TEXT:
Corrigendum to Advertisement No. 1/2025
The last date for submitting online Applications for the posts of Assistant
Professor in various subjects in the Panjab University Constituent Colleges
(Funded by Punjab Government) is extended upto 27.05.2025. Further, the
last date for submitting hard copies of online application along with supporting
documents in the office of the Deputy Registrar (Estt.), Panjab University,
Chandigarh is 09.06.2025 up to 4:00 P.M.
-sd/-
